scene_sentence_zh: 鋪著石板的主要街道上人來人往，攤販的叫賣聲與馬車的輪聲此起彼落。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: a painted medieval town street opening into a cobbled market square, pale stone and half-timbered houses with steep tiled roofs lining both sides, red canvas market awnings and hanging heraldic banners bearing no readable text, an old stone fountain at the far end of the square, a few tiny indistinct townspeople in the distance, an open cobbled avenue filling the lower foreground in warm afternoon light

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: a painterly JRPG medieval town street opening into a cobbled market square of half-timbered and pale stone houses with red tiled roofs, red canvas market awnings, a stone fountain, hanging banners bearing only heraldic symbols and chalkboards bearing only unreadable pseudo-script, tiny indistinct townspeople in the distance, and an open cobbled avenue across the lower foreground; no interface, watermark, readable lettering or forest reuse.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop (browser method web.tests.browser.test_browser_bundled_scene_assets.BundledSceneAssetsBrowserTest.test_terminal_pack_static_decode): the full-bleed composition holds and the illustration stays distinguishable from its sibling at that viewport.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed as a two-up contact sheet beside forest_path: scene identity, palette and composition are distinct for both terminal members.
